title: pH and Quantitative Acid-Base Reasoning
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: pH scale and concentration data reasoning using tables and graphs. No chemical testing is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for pH, rate factors, catalysts, equilibrium, and real-world claims
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: pH scale and concentration data reasoning
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the macro or micro pH view that shows pH and particle information. Test water, one acidic solution, and one basic solution from the simulation's available liquids. Read the pH value and inspect hydronium and hydroxide information or particle amounts when available. Record liquid name, pH, acid/base/neutral classification, hydronium-hydroxide comparison, and the lesson conclusion.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
